Description []

Line 3 is a line that runs in an north-south orientation along the east of Deepond Island. It is line Number 3 of Deepond Light Rail and is represented by red.

Route Planning[]

Line 3 was originally divided into two lines: East Pond Line and Gravies Line. East Pond Line began from Heaping Shoal to Godplain Tourist Area (Now called Kamibara Tourist Area Station), while Gravies Line began from Gravies West (Now called West Pond) to Deepond Park (Now called East Pond). Two routes interchanges at Deepond Park Station.

In the third route reform, these two routes were split into several sections:

  • Gravies West - Deepond Park: Now Line 4 West Pond to Kamibara and Line 3 Kamibara to East Pond. This section was originally planned to have 3 stations, after Deepond South Reclaimation, Tai Wah and South Pond station were proposed and merged to Line 4.
  • Deepond Park - Deepond Lighthouse: Now Line 3 East Pond to Deepond Lighthouse. This section used to pass Hai-Kou River station, after East Coast Reef Reclaimation, a new station East Coast Reef was proposed and thus adjusted the shape of line. Now passengers needs to transfer at East Coast Road Station to interchange with Line 1 and Line 2.
  • Deepond Light House - Star Pond: Originally Line 3A section to serve NFC pier.

Districts Served[]

  • West Metropolis Archipelago
    • Deepond Island

Fun Facts[]

  • The representative color of this line was originally purple. However, after lines reformation, this line was merged with Gravies Line and changed color to red.
  • This line was originally planned to open in 2 phases, while phase 1 opens from Deepond North Pier to Deepond Lighthouse and phase 2 covers the remaining section.

  • June 20 2023: This station began operations with Line 3.
  • May 26 2025: The lift (Exit C) of this station was put in use.
  • May 27 2025: Line 2 began operations for this station.
  • November 26 2025: Line 6 began operations for this station.

Description []

Delta Line is one of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It passes through Prymea, Cometsilk, Punctual, Flask, Downtown, Sava, West Metropolis Archipelago and Peckern.

This line is represented by Light Green on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number D.

Currently, this line is 48.56 km long, with a total of 10 stations.

History[]

Development Chapters[]

  • S2E3: Metropolis - Jayler
  • S2E4: Metropolis - Purple Gate
  • S2E10: Metropolis - Purplaetus
  • S2E17: Nail Bight - Purplaetus
  • S3E15: Arrowhead - Purplaetus

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Down Extend to the Southeast of Nail Bight Checkpoint and interchange once with Cometsilk Line once again.[1] Completed
(Chapter: S3E15)

Districts Served[]

  • Prymea
  • Cometsilk
  • Punctual
  • Flask
  • Downtown
    • Bonyal (Passes Through)
  • Sava
    • Threeler
  • West Metropolis Archipelago
    • Belt Island
  • Peckern

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • This line is currently the longest Veloduct in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division at 48.56km.
  • This line provides Express Services for the following lines:
    • East Ring Line: Metropolis to Kelper Mount. [2]
    • New Edward Line (East): Metropolis to Nail Bight (Through Flask South). [3]
    • Arcgo Line (West): Metropolis to Jayler. [4]
    • Cometsilk Line: Nail Bight to Arrowhead
    • Phoenix Line: Metropolis to Arrowhead (Through Nail Bight)

Fun Facts[]

  • This line was originally planned to be a short-range express service of Arcgo Line (Between Metropolis Terminal and Jayler Station).
  • Belt Island Station and Purple Gate Station were formerly single-lined stations of this line, but in 2017, they became interchanges with Interisland Line and Expo Line respectively.
  • The section between Metropolis and Arrowhead serves as the Express Service of more than one Standard Railway Line:
    • Metropolis to Nail Bight: New Edward Line, Phoenix Line
    • Nail Bight to Arrowhead: Cometsilk Line, Phoenix Line

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station makes use of Numbered and Lettered Platforms, with Platforms ending with letters instead of simply using numbers. Platforms ending with the letter "A" are served by Line 2800, whereas Platforms 1B and 2B serves Line INN-04, and Platforms 3B and 4B serves Line INN-08. This is also the first such instance in Los Sengas.

Desert Field Station is a station on Urban Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Sava. Passengers may also use this station to change to Downtown Transit Sirius Line (Desert Field Station) and SLT Line 212 Desert Field NR Station Stop, where passengers can in turn travel to South Field NR Station Stop and change to Nazca Railway Swift Line (South Field Station).

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1
  • Find the Original Chinese Name of this station at the buttons at the four corners of this station.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of Coarse Dirt.

Fun Facts[]

  • While this station was originally meant to be named Sha Tin Station, which in turn alludes to the MTR station of the same name, it was later changed to the current name.
  • The entirety of the station structure is located beneath Route 1.
  • The entirety of the platform structure is sealed off by the wool in this station. Therefore, despite being a ground station, this station would appear to be an underground station.

History[]

  • August 6 2015: This station began services.
  • June 18 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[3]
  • June 8 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • July 22 2020: This station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[5]
  • March 3 2021: Exit E3 is added to this station to connect to Desert Field NR Station Stop, where passengers can then travel to Swift Line South Field Station using SLT Line 212.[6]
  • March 11 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[7]

title: Diamond Bay Depot
safeHtml:
Diamond Bay Depot is one of the depots of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division, and it began services on March 10 2021. It is located at Los Sengas Twenty-Second Continent, and this Depot provides services for Akashi Line, Daybreaker Line and Vision Line.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Depot Structure
    • 2.1 Stabling Sidings
    • 2.2 Depot Platforms
    • 2.3 Maintenance Pit
    • 2.4 Cranes and Loading Sidings
    • 2.5 Connecting Tracks
  • 3 Gallery
  • 4 Citations and References

Description[]

Diamond Bay Depot is located at the south peninsula of Los Sengas Twenty-Second Continent, and has a total area of 28.3 Hectares.

Depot Structure[]

Stabling Sidings[]

This Depot can hold 90 trains, with 35 sidings, 25 tracks 408 m long and 10 tracks 816 m long.

Depot Platforms[]

This Depot has 2 island platforms, each having Standard Length (204 m). However, they do not feature Platform Screen Doors.

Maintenance Pit[]

There are four Maintenance Pits.

Cranes and Loading Sidings[]

This Depot has three piers, featuring loading docks for train loading as maritime exits and entrances.

Connecting Tracks[]

There are four exits to the north of this depot, two connecting to Akashi Line and two connecting to Vision Line, and the Akashi Line tracks are also connected to Daybreaker Line. Trains on Daybreaker Line have to use Akashi Line tracks to access this depot, but this depot provides direct access to Diamond Pool Station as well.

title: Diamond Pool
safeHtml:
Diamond Pool is one of the Sub-Districts of Twenty-Second Continent. It is located at the opposite side of Tai Wan Peninsula. Currently, it has been developed as a residential area, and is the most densely populated area in Twenty-Second Continent.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Main Housing Estates
    • 2.1 On Ting Estate
    • 2.2 Yau Oi Estate
    • 2.3 Tin Kung Court
  • 3 Problems
  • 4 Transport
    • 4.1 Routes
    • 4.2 Nazca Railway
    • 4.3 Local Road
  • 5 Citations and References

History[]

In 2017, Southern Loop had plans to build a station in this area called Yodoko. However, due to historical reasons, Southern Loop plans had been abolished.

On December 2019, further development in Twenty-Second continent began, and decided that it wold be easier to begin development at Diamond Pond, which is the only area that provides external road access in Twenty-Second Continent at the time. Therefore, this place is first founded as a residential district consisted of public housing, and this area is renamed Diamond Pond, based on the Route 7 bridge of the same name.

Main Housing Estates[]

On Ting Estate[]

On Ting Estate provides 10'880 housing flats in its 17 buildings, and features On Ting Shopping Mall for residential use.

Yau Oi Estate[]

Yau Oi Estate is located to the coast, and provides 4'080 hosuing flats in its 8 buildings. A bridge is also available for connection to On Ting Estate.

Tin Kung Court[]

Tin Kung Court is located to the opposite side of On Ting Estate, and provides 2'880 housing flats in its 8 buildlings. However, all its flats have a design of alternate floors, and this led to criticism from its residents. Tin Kung Court may be one of the last housing courts to adopt the "alternate floors" design.

Problems[]

  • Lack of Recreational Facilities

Despite being home to a population of 30 thousand, On Ting Estate only had 4 basketball courts and two tennis courts. The absence of a Soccer Field also meant that there is a severe recreational facility deficiency in On Ting Estate. However, after the completion of Good Queen Anne Memorial Park between Diamond Pool and Halozy, this porblem may be alleviated. That park features 16 basketball courts, 4 soccier fields, 4 tennis courts, 4 volleyball courts and a Standard Olympic-sized Swimming Pool with a audience stand.

  • Lack of Bus Suppply

Despite this sub-district having a population of 45 thousand, there are only 5 bus lines providign external access. Most busese are already sautrated upon leaving On Ting Estate Bus Terminus, and rendered passengers waiting at the stations in the middle unable to board. However, May & Lisette, the main bus company, already promised an increase in bus services and more direct routes, and possible footbridges connecting to Kou Fu Sui Station and Inception Bay Station would also be built in the future.

  • Lack of Student Quotas

While a Primary School and Secondary School are planned for Diamond Pool, they were still under construction by the time all the residents moved into Diamond Pool. As a results, students have to detour to Old Brightland, Downtown and even Sava for studies. This increases transport demand and further worsens traffic problems.。

Transport[]

Routes[]

  • Route 7

Nazca Railway[]

  • West Ring Line Inception Bay Station
  • Akashi Line, Vision Line Diamond Pool Station

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the permanent Down Direction Terminus of Vision Line.
  • This Station is the first station to use Mossy Stone Bricks in Nazca Railway.[2]
  • Conventionally, Platforms involving lines of a larger number are placed below that with lines of a smaller number. However, in the case of this station, as Akashi Line needs to access Strait of Freedom Tunnel, the Akashi Line Platforms are placed lower than Vision Line Platforms.
  • Signboards involving characters from the game SINoALICE are placed at the concourse of this station, with the characters involved being Alice, Snow White, Cinderella, Gretel, Dornröschen (Sleeping Beauty), Red Riding Hood, Kaguya, Little Mermaid and Dorothy.

History[]

  • January 24 2021: This station began construction.
  • January 26 2021: This station completed construction.[3]
  • January 27 2021: This station began services alongside Akashi Line, but Vision Line platforms remain reserved.
  • March 2 2021: Vision Line is established.
  • August 15 2021: Akashi Line increased train speeds between this station and Freedom Bay Station.[4]

  • The station number of Evillow Line for this station was EV-03. However, it has later been changed to EV-05 due to Station Number rearrangements.

Fun Facts[]

  • The name and design of this station corresponds to the Up Quark, one of the six types of Quarks.[2] To correspond to the element of "Down", the following elements are incorporated:
    • The colored glass panes of the concourse, as well as the blue wool of the pillars at the platform, are located at the lower area of its glass pane and the pillar respectively.
    • This station is located at a lower altitude than Up Clearings Station.

History[]

  • January 10 2020: This station began services.
  • January 12 2020: A pedestrian walkway connecting to this station is added.[3]
  • April 10 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[4]

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Pavement's Descent.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first station to be built in 2019.
  • The Akashi Line Platforms of this Station features the very first set of Platforms to be built with a slope in Nazca Railway to create the conditions to enter the Downdike Bay Tunnel towards Sharp Spit Station. However, the first set of Platforms to be built with a slope is at Downtown Transit Shore Tip Station.
  • The mD Signs at this station for both lines is "57".
  • While the platform layout of this station resembles Longwington Station, the Minecraft Line Concourse of this station is located at ground level, and bridges are also available for passengers to cross over to the other platform, unlike Longwington Station where this access is done at the Concourse.
  • A "Dragon Tail" is featured at the Female Lavatory of this station.

History[]

  • January 3 2019: This Station began construction.
  • January 4 2019: This Station completed construction.
  • January 6 2019: This station began services alongside Minecraft Line.
  • August 29 2020: The Akashi Line Part of this station began expansion.
  • August 30 2020: The Akashi Line Platforms and Concourse completed expansion. At the same day, Akashi Line extends from Walnut Tree Station to this station.
  • April 19 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • March 2 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[2]
  • June 5 2025: The Station Icon of this station is added.

Downtown Loop Line is one of the lines in Period 1 of the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. It is operated by Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu (TKD) and runs within Downtown. Besides of a circular line section, a branch line is also set up between Luk Pak Yung Chuen and Metro Stone Station. Passengers can access that branch line using the Inner Ring Platform at Luk Pak Yung Chuen and Platform 3 of On King Court. All platforms are overground. Among all stations on the line, Caca Road Interchange Station is the only station with two concourses.

Downwell Sand DT Station Stop is a station of SLT Line 203. It is located at Los Sengas Sava. This station will serve Line 204 and Line 205 in the future, and passengers may also use this station to change to Nazca Railway Luxter Line (Downwell Sand Station), Downtown Transit Sirius Line, Sirius Express (Downwell Sand Station) and NR Buses Route R20.

Downwell Sand Station is a station on Luxter Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Sava. Passengers may also use this station to change to Downtown Transit Sirius Line, Sirius Express (Downwell Sand Station), SLT Line 203 (Downwell Sand DT Station Stop) and NR Buses Route R20.

Station Souvenir Hints (Now Demolished)[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.

  • Stars: 4
  • Two Players are required.
  • Step on the Pressure Plates at the same time.
  • Try solving the puzzle
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of glass.

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • Take note of the decoration above the ceiling of the concourse.
  • Take the blocks of iron as the left side and only leave the sand at the position of the golden bricks.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a Piece of Light Blue Stained Glass Pane.

Fun Facts[]

  • The design of this station alludes to Olympic Station of the MTR in Hong Kong with regards that a set of through tracks pass between the platforms of this station, and that this station, like Olympic Station, is also light blue.[4]
  • While this station used to have a Los Sengas Coffee at the Concourse, it has since been demolished.[5]

History[]

  • April 9 2015: This station began services.
  • February 24 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[6]
  • January 2 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[7]
  • May 27 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[8]
  • January 6 2021: The Luxter Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[9]
  • April 9 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[10]
  • May 29 2022: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[11]

Dragon Isle is one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is a subsidiary isle of Haber Island.

Location[]

Dragon Isle is located to the east of Twenty-Second Continent, the west of Yashi Island and the north of Fishtail Isle, Twin Lava Isle and Haber Island.

Fun Facts[]

  • Southern Loop also had plans to set up a Station on this isle. However, due to changes in development plans, the plans never came to fruition.
